verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms LegalZoom publishes an llms.txt at https://www.legalzoom.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), headed as guidance for AI crawlers, so a user can point an agent at it. The probe excerpt is truncated, so its depth and usefulness for agent tasks are unverified. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's substantive content and coverage, broader agent-oriented docs beyond crawler guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability
